meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会替你走完整个发布流程:确认版本号、触发 GitHub Actions 发布、核对 npm 包与 GitHub Release、写好发布说明并尝试发 Discord 公告;过程中不做代码审查,除非你明确要求。
howto.when: 当你说出“publish”“release”“deploy”等词,或要求发布到 npm,并给出版本类型(patch/minor/major)时触发;没给版本类型时它会先问你。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 会触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程并核对结果。

say.text: 请发 minor 版本到 npm
say.note: 会按新功能发布,并完成后续核对。

say.text: 用 major 版本发布并部署
say.note: 会当作破坏性变更发布,备注迁移提示。

howto.what_en: Claude drives the full release: confirms the version bump, triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, verifies npm packages and the GitHub release, drafts the summary, and attempts a Discord announcement. No code review during publish unless requested.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'publish', 'release', 'deploy', or ask for an npm release, and provide a bump type (patch/minor/major). If no bump type is given, it asks first.

say_en.note: Triggers the workflow and verifies the release.

say_en.text: Release a minor version to npm
say_en.note: Publishes as new features and verifies results.
Treats as breaking change and adds migration notes.
